title: Keyboard Shortcuts Reference
description: Complete list of keyboard shortcuts for power users

steps.title: Global Shortcuts
steps.description: Ctrl+N: New note | Ctrl+Shift+N: Quick capture | Ctrl+Shift+/: Describe It | Ctrl+K: Command palette | ?: Help

steps.title: Navigation Shortcuts
steps.description: Ctrl+1: Notes | Ctrl+2: Network | Ctrl+3: Map | Ctrl+4: Timeline | Ctrl+5: Matches | Ctrl+6: Chat | Ctrl+7: Skills

steps.title: Editor Shortcuts
steps.description: Ctrl+Enter: Save | Escape: Cancel | Ctrl+D: Add detail | Tab: Indent | Shift+Tab: Outdent | Ctrl+B: Bold | Ctrl+I: Italic

steps.title: View Shortcuts
steps.description: Ctrl+F: Search | Ctrl+Shift+F: Advanced filter | V: Toggle view mode | G: Group by | S: Sort

steps.title: Open Shortcuts Help
steps.description: Press ? anywhere to open the shortcuts reference

steps.title: Customize Shortcuts
steps.description: Go to Settings → Shortcuts to customize or disable any shortcut
